Built for the ride

Weatherproof

All Dakota Digital motorcycle gauges are designed to survive in the weather. The circuit boards are internally coated, so even if water gets into the housing they will not be damaged.

Made for vibration

Machined aluminum housings with the circuit board mounts built into the machine work, designed with big stroker motors in mind.

Readable in the sun

MLX instruments use high-visibility TFT displays with a high-contrast sunlight mode. Most universal gauges use teal displays with non-glare lenses.
